d: The Hornets defeated the Cavaliers, 124-112 tonight in Charlotte. Grayson Allen contributed a team-high 27 points to go with 6 assists 6 three pointers and 4 rebounds, with Naz Reid of the Hornets adding an additional 25 points (10-26 FG, 4-9 3P) in the game. Meleek Thomas finished with a team-high 18 points along with 4 three pointers for the Cavaliers in the losing effort. The Hornets improve their record to 4-7 with the win, while the Cavaliers fall to 5-6 for the season.
